critical_boundaries: Khalazar initially title, not a verified personal name; early phonetic incantations are not automatic identity matches
Translation, captive testimony, interested aboleth/rat claims, guardian account and ritual vision retain evidence classes
Early private Kalizar utterance not shared omniscience
S2E10 apparition/shade defeated, Anthela rescued; physical death not backdated
S2E12 possession/Drone do not place own corporeal body at Ball or establish willing allegiance of hosts
Audience-only Mummy Lord CR15 disclosure not PC knowledge or proof of physical biology
Creator drow/pale-elf art direction not every generic D&D trait or an in-world racial announcement
Dream appearances distinct from immobile desiccated body, final combat image and actual physical destruction
Blood ancestry remains hypothesis; organ placement performed but separate wrist-blood drop not explicit
Urn component identities and custody progress chronologically, with early unopened contents not backfilled as examined
Shared historical/rebuilt-city visions not independently authenticated history or a physically restored present city
Darmah knockdown recovery unrecorded; allies unconscious not confirmed dead
Koh final apparent strike followed by all three original Delvers driving psychic dagger into real heart; final defeat affirmative
Unused iron-golem fight, flying empire, evil-lieutenant outcome and vampire alliance are counterfactuals only
All ten skeletal minotaurs become inert bones; Noble Hollow fertile and dungeon danger wanes, not universal creature extermination
Character structural readiness not complete factual acceptance; previous inventory preserved before refresh
